stories.title: Nordic countries move toward a common defence deal
stories.summary: Norway said the Nordic countries will work toward a joint defence arrangement, deepening regional military cooperation. The push comes as European governments reassess security guarantees and procurement in the wake of the Ukraine war.

stories.title: G7 warns China's actions east of Taiwan threaten stability
stories.summary: G7 foreign ministers meeting in Paris issued a joint declaration saying China's increasingly assertive actions in the waters east of Taiwan threaten regional stability and freedom of navigation. The statement adds coordinated Western pressure on Beijing over its military posture near the island.

stories.title: Russia says it hit Ukrainian military factories in massive overnight strike
stories.summary: Russia's defence ministry said it launched a large overnight strike on Ukrainian military-industrial facilities as Moscow and Kyiv traded attacks on each other's capitals. The escalation came hours before US envoys sat down with Vladimir Putin.

stories.title: Kushner and Witkoff arrive in Moscow for Putin peace talks
stories.summary: US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff landed in Moscow for talks with Vladimir Putin, the 10th in-person Witkoff-Putin meeting of the push to end the war. It follows two days of US-mediated trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi that yielded a planned prisoner exchange but no breakthrough on territory.

stories.title: Who could replace Jensen Huang? TechCrunch runs the list
stories.summary: With Nvidia's board reportedly weighing a change at the top, TechCrunch circulated a self-described unscientific list of possible successors to CEO Jensen Huang. The speculation matters because Nvidia's leadership is now a market-wide risk factor for the AI buildout.

stories.title: Critical RCE flaw found in Apache HTTP Server
stories.summary: Wiz published details of CVE-2026-119618, a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server, warning that unpatched servers are exposed. The disclosure shot to the top of Hacker News as administrators scrambled to patch internet-facing deployments.

stories.title: The Jensen Huang scandal, assembled into a timeline
stories.summary: TechCrunch laid out how allegations that Nvidia's CEO had an affair with a woman linked to Chinese intelligence unfolded, from the first reports to the board's response. Nvidia's board and federal authorities are examining whether trade secrets were compromised.

stories.title: Monken: 'fun' Sanders exchange, no plans to bench O-linemen
stories.summary: Browns coach Todd Monken downplayed a sideline exchange with Shedeur Sanders over play selection and said he has no plans to bench any of his offensive linemen. Deshaun Watson remains the starter for Sunday's home game against Houston, his former team.

stories.title: Ohio State falls to No. 20, its lowest CFP ranking ever
stories.summary: The second College Football Playoff rankings of 2026 dropped Ohio State from No. 12 to No. 20 after the 41-28 home loss to Oregon, the lowest the program has ever sat in the CFP era. At 6-3 the Buckeyes no longer control their postseason fate and need help to reach the Big Ten title game.

stories.title: Meyer: Buckeyes 'still in the hunt'; Tressel says never say never
stories.summary: Urban Meyer said Ohio State is still in the hunt for a Big Ten and national title, while Jim Tressel refused to rule out a three-loss CFP bid ahead of Saturday's game against Northwestern. Ryan Day, meanwhile, said he is evaluating his staff weekly and reaffirmed Luke Fahey as starting quarterback.

stories.title: Racing Bulls confirm Lawson and Lindblad for 2027
stories.summary: Racing Bulls will keep an unchanged line-up next season, with Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad both extending. The announcement settles one of the last open seats and leaves Haas as the main remaining question on the 2027 grid.

stories.title: Pirelli confirms revised wet tyres for 2027 after Brazil criticism
stories.summary: Pirelli will bring a new specification of intermediate and full wet tyres next year after drivers complained about grip and warm-up at Interlagos. The new rubber is due for FIA homologation in December, with the problems partly tied to 2026's stiffer constructions and higher pressures.

stories.title: Ex-Liberty boss predicts F1 will be sold and taken private
stories.summary: Greg Maffei, former president and CEO of Liberty Media, told Sportico's Invest New York conference that Formula 1's days as a publicly traded business may be numbered and that he expects the series to be sold. Liberty's share structure has been shifting, with John Malone's voting power recently falling to about 3%.

stories.title: Alpine minority shareholder steps up effort to sell stake
stories.summary: Otro Capital has appointed bankers BDT and MSD Partners to explore the sale of its 24% holding in the Alpine F1 team, according to Sportico. The move comes despite months of speculation linking buyers including Toto Wolff and Christian Horner to the Enstone outfit.

stories.title: OhioHealth plans $700M hospital at former Big Lots HQ
stories.summary: OhioHealth will invest $700 million to build a hospital at the former Big Lots headquarters in northeast Columbus, with an opening targeted for 2030. The project adds a major inpatient campus to the fast-growing New Albany corridor.

stories.title: Mifflin Township disbands its police department after levy fails
stories.summary: Mifflin Township trustees voted to shut down the township's police division after voters rejected a levy last week. Trustees called the decision painful, and the Franklin County community is now without its own police force.

stories.title: Brunch chain adds northeast Columbus location, plans Dublin-area site
stories.summary: A brunch eatery is entering the Columbus market with a restaurant in northeast Columbus near New Albany and a second location planned near Dublin. It is the latest out-of-market chain to target the region's growing northern suburbs.
